last KB update: 2026-07-03T21:22:02Z

⚠️ ImportSubscriber (monitor 299551472) anomaly — flagging outside the normal score gate

method-import-subscriber has shown ZERO telemetry (no AMQP hits, no HTTP traces, no logs of any kind — not even errors) for 11+ hours, since 2026-07-04T00:08:32Z, still ongoing at scan time (~11:09Z).

This is categorically different from all 39 prior mentions of this monitor (0/39 ever DM-worthy) — every prior fire self-recovered within roughly 30-90 minutes. Meanwhile method-import-api (job submission) has continued steady, healthy traffic the entire time (5,663 hits across the window) — which argues against the standing "quiet queue" explanation used for every prior fire, and for either a stuck/crashed subscriber process or a broken telemetry pipeline for that service.

Could not confirm further: no SQL template exists for import-queue depth (Hard rule #2 blocks ad-hoc SQL), no SSH/host access in this routine's tool set, and method-import-subscriber's repo isn't in CLAUDE.md's catalog or resolvable via gh this cycle.

Mechanical escalation score came out to 0 (below the actionable threshold) because the scoring rubric is calibrated on this monitor's historical noise profile and has no signal for "duration of an unresolved gap" — logged as actionable-high-borderline rather than a #triage-results post, but wanted you to see this directly given the potential for a real, growing backlog of unprocessed customer import jobs.

Full write-up: docs/investigations/2026-07-04-fa31d9a48398fe99.md

Also: the 2 other findings this cycle (EDA-consumer AMQP 3rd-occurrence deviation, and a housekeeping first-notify for the grid-dropdown synthetics family) were posted to #triage-results.

⚠️ Follow-up: ImportSubscriber (monitor 299551472) anomaly still unresolved.

Re-checked at 12:16Z (was first flagged at 11:09Z as an 11h+ telemetry-silence anomaly). method-import-subscriber AMQP hits are still zero through this new window too — total silence now ~12h08m since 2026-07-04T00:08:32Z, not self-recovered. method-import-api (job submission) traffic remains steady, so the queue is presumably still growing.

No new #triage-results post (same underlying issue, no new state-change event this cycle) and no new investigation doc — this is a compact status delta on docs/investigations/2026-07-04-fa31d9a48398fe99.md. Flagging since duration is now the dominant signal and the standing "quiet queue" explanation looks less likely the longer this runs.

Update on the ImportSubscriber telemetry-silence thread from ~11:09Z (fa31d9a4): the ~15h total-silence picture just changed. DD metric shows exactly one AMQP burst all day — 793 msgs at 14:20-14:30Z — then it went quiet again, and the No-Data monitor re-tripped at 15:03Z. So it's not fully dead, but it's not recovered either — looks like a flapping/intermittent consumer rather than a clean fix. method-import-api traffic unchanged throughout (flat ~42/5min, doesn't confirm real import backpressure either way). Filed as `docs/actionable/2026-07-04.md#0e7cdc5d`, full detail in docs/investigations/2026-07-04-0e7cdc5da17bf310.md. Separately: DD monitor 302057011 (runtime-core-subscriber throughput stall) also re-fired a 2nd time today (15:10Z) — same benign-looking shape as its first fire, filed to actionable.md only, not re-posted.
